	t.Parallel()

	files := `

disableKinds = ['rss','sitemap','taxonomy','term']
-- layouts/_default/list.html --
__|{{ range .Pages }}{{ .Title }}|{{ end }}__
-- layouts/_default/single.html --
{{ .Title }}|
-- content/s1/_index.md --
---
title: s1
---
-- content/s1/p1.md --
---
title: p1
---
-- content/s1-foo/_index.md --
---
title: s1-foo
---
-- content/s1/p2.md --
---
title: p2
---
  `

	b := Test(t, files)

	b.AssertFileContent("public/index.html", "__|s1|s1-foo|__")
}
EOF

func TestPagesSimilarSectionNames(t *testing.T) {
	files := `

-- content/draftsection/_index.md --
---
draft: true
---
-- content/draftsection/sub/_index.md --got
-- content/draftsection/sub/d1.md --
-- content/s1/_index.md --
-- content/s1/p1.md --
-- content/s1-foo/_index.md --
-- content/s1-foo/p2.md --
-- content/s1-foo/s2/_index.md --
-- content/s1-foo/s2/p3.md --
-- content/s1-foo/s2-foo/_index.md --
-- content/s1-foo/s2-foo/p4.md --
-- layouts/_default/list.html --
{{ .RelPermalink }}: Pages: {{ range .Pages }}{{ .RelPermalink }}|{{ end }}$

`
	b := Test(t, files)

	b.AssertFileContent("public/index.html", "/: Pages: /s1-foo/|/s1/|$")

	b.AssertFileContent("public/s1-foo/s2/index.html", "/s1-foo/s2/: Pages: /s1-foo/s2/p3/|$")
}

part.text:
Implemented the fix in `hugolib/content_map_page.go:getPagesInSection`.

The non-recursive page walk now skips every encountered branch’s descendants via `SkipPrefix`, instead of tracking only one branch prefix. This prevents pages under similarly named adjacent sections (e.g. `s1` and `s1-foo`) from leaking into `.Pages`.

Validated:
- `TestPagesSimilarSectionNames` passes
- Full `go test ./hugolib -count=1` passes
